en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional-style conscription song; origin unclear. 'Војниќе' in the last stanza I read as a variant of 'војниче' (young soldier).

lines.en: Do not cry, our birth mothers,
do not grieve, our dear fathers.
Rejoice, mother or father,

lines.cyr: што се си сина вие родиле.
lines.lat: što se si sina vie rodile.
lines.en: that you gave birth to a son.
Sing a cheerful song,
tomorrow we go as soldiers.
Tomorrow we go as soldiers,
young soldiers, young recruits.
Rejoice, mother or father,

lines.cyr: што се си сина вие родиле,
lines.lat: što se si sina vie rodile,
lines.en: that you gave birth to a son,
you gave birth to a son and waited
to send him off to the army.
Sing a cheerful song,
tomorrow we go as soldiers.
Tomorrow we go as soldiers,
young soldiers, young recruits.

lines.cyr: Не плачи либе и ти по мене
lines.lat: Ne plači libe i ti po mene
lines.en: Do not cry for me either, sweetheart,

lines.cyr: не рони солзи по бело лице,
lines.lat: ne roni solzi po belo lice,
lines.en: do not shed tears down your white face,
but go home, prepare gifts,

lines.cyr: в' година ќе дојдам, тебе ќе земам.
lines.lat: v' godina ḱe dojdam, tebe ḱe zemam.
lines.en: in a year I will come, I will take you.
Sing me, dear, a cheerful song,
tomorrow I will be a young soldier.
Tomorrow I will be a young soldier,

lines.cyr: в' година ќе дојдам, тебе ќе земам.
lines.lat: v' godina ḱe dojdam, tebe ḱe zemam.
lines.en: in a year I will come, I will take you.
